name: Etherium
description: A magical alloy infused with the power of the Blind Eternities.

description_citations.text: "Test of Metal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vronos studies etherium and the Twenty-Three Texts with the Ethersworn, repairs his face with an etherium infix and mask, and learns to planeswalk and track other planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: he honed his planeswalking skill and discovered how to track others like himself by the faint trails they left in the Æther.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Breya discovers carmot in Jund and replaces most of her body with etherium she created herself.
timeline.quote: To prove her achievement, Breya replaced the majority of her organic body with etherium she created herself.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Silas Renn rises in the Seekers of Carmot and receives the first etherium heart.
timeline.quote: he was honored with the first etherium heart ever produced

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Breya rediscovers sangrite in Jund and forges the first new etherium in centuries.
timeline.quote: The young artificer Breya rediscovered Sangrite in Jund , forging the first new etherium in centuries.

citation.text: "Esper", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Etherium is said to have been created by the sphinx Crucius.
timeline.quote: Said to have been first created by the sphinx Crucius

citation.text: "Etherium". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Breya becomes the first to create etherium from sangrite harvested from Jund, replacing most of her body with it.
timeline.quote: The young human artificer Breya was the first to create etherium from sangrite harvested from Jund.
